label: Bangladesh consumer price inflation (BBS)
notes: 12-month average inflation per fiscal year (July-June). FY2024-25 (10.03%) and FY2025-26 (8.68%) are from BBS releases reported in The Financial Express (July 2026); earlier years are BBS annual averages.
September 2026 point-to-point inflation 8.34% (food 7.22%, non-food 9.30%) per BBS, reported by UNB and Dhaka Tribune (Oct 2026).
